resources.string: Choose card size, cover style, and favorite marks for your games and apps.
AI-extended covers fill wide cards. When unavailable, the original cover is shown with a background in its own colors.
The whole cover stays visible, with a soft background in its own colors.
The whole cover on a plain background, keeping its original proportions.
The cover fills the card. Some edges may be cropped.
The same size applies to games and apps, on the home screen and in the library. Text size stays the same.
